Casa Karina Aparthotel

Address: 100 m from the cabin ski lift and Kempinski hotel, Bansko

GPS: 41° 49′33′′N 23°28′46′′E

Location: Casa Karina Aparthotel is located 100 m from the Gondola ski lift in Bansko resort at the foot of the Pirin mountain. The hotel is situated 250 meters from the Pirin Park and about 1000 meters from the center of Bansko.

Accommodation: The property features 80 studios, one bedroom apartments and two bedroom apartments. The guestrooms are fully furnished. They offer spacious bathrooms and splendid Pirin and Rila mountain views.

Spa centre: The spa centre offers Finnish sauna, Turkish bath, steam bath, fitness hall, rooms for massages and indoor swimming pool with 30 C water temperature. The pool features South exposure and view to the mountain. There are sunbeds near the pool and at the English yard.

Wine and Dine: The restaurant with 180 seats and two fireplaces offers local specialties, Bulgarian and international cuisine and selected wine list. The hotel features a bar and a summer garden with barbecue and children`s corner.

The coffee-bar with 30 seats is located near reception. It is equipped with TV-set and billiards.

Conference facilities: The hotel offers a conference hall with 60 seats, multimedia and necessarily equipment for conferences and business events.

Services:
- Luggage compartment;
- Free of charge outdoor parking and guarded garage;
- Compartment for storage of ski equipment;
- Wireless Internet connection – paid service;
- Laundry – paid service;
- Room-service – paid service.

Extras:

  • Children's entertaining programs (paid), Children's playground, Ваbysitter (on request, paid) (10 € p/h), Baby cot (2.55 € p/d), Children's room;
  • Ski and Snowboard Depot, Table tennis;
  • Billiards (paid), Game machines (paid);
  • Pets allowed (5 kg max, 5.12 € p/d).
**Hotel rooms may vary in size and style. Guests can be accommodated in a different room from the images shown here as examples only.
